skill.descTemplate:
使用声骸技能，幻形为双极·渊陨重锋，快速射击敌人，持续5秒，每段攻击造成{0}的导电伤害。
在首位装配该声骸技能时，自身导电伤害加成提升{6}，普攻伤害加成提升{7}。
技能冷却：{11}秒
自身同时装配双极·星升辉铳时：
·使用声骸技能后，声骸技能在双极·星升辉铳、双极·渊陨重锋中交替更变，但视为同名声骸技能。
·双极·渊陨重锋的伤害类型将变为衍射伤害，且首位装配该声骸技能时获得的导电伤害加成将变为衍射伤害加成。
·施放普攻时获得{1}层【双极律动】，施放共鸣技能时获得{2}层【双极律动】，可叠加{3}层，持续{4}秒，每层可以使该声骸技能造成的伤害提升{5}，该声骸技能效果结束后清除全部层数。
·可使用次数上限变为{10}次，初始拥有{8}次可使用次数，每{9}秒可使用次数增加1次。

skill.descEnRank5:
Transform into a Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade to rapidly fire at enemies for 5s, with each attack dealing 2.01% Electro DMG.

The Resonator with this Echo equipped in the main slot gains 12.00% Electro DMG Bonus and 12.00% Basic Attack DMG Bonus.

CD: 8s.

If Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon is equipped in another slot on the Resonator:
- Casting Echo Skill in succession transforms you into Collapsar Blade and Nebulous Cannon alternately and is considered casting Echo skills of the same name.
- DMG dealt by Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade becomes Spectro DMG. The Electro DMG Bonus gained from equipping it in the main slot is turned into Spectro DMG Bonus.
- Casting Basic Attacks grants 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of Dyad Origins. Casting Resonance Skill grants 3 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Dyad Origins. Dyad Origins can stack up to 6 times and lasts for 8s. Each stack increases Echo Skill DMG by 10%, and all stacks are cleared after this Echo Skill ends.
- This skill is capped at 2 uses. Initially, this skill can be used 2 times, with 1 use added every 8s.
skill.simple:

同时装配双极·星升辉铳时，声骸技能将具有额外的特殊效果。
